svg.text: Adventurer world: the four scenes at a 900px lane, with the bed and sleeper, the hero in all six outfits, mobs and props
Forest 20:00 (late dusk: sun down, first stars) · backdrop 4,393 chars
Cavern (the same at every hour) · backdrop 6,378 chars
Night 3:00 (the moon has crossed) · backdrop 4,725 chars
The forest at every hour (a 290px lane each): the sky, sun, moon and stars follow the local hour; the cabin window shows the same sky
cabin at a 1400px lane (scaled to fit)
Terminal (10 sprite px tall): background colour, bed with the sleeper, a standing hero and a prop
Props at 6x (WORLD_PAL); the cracks are shown over BLOCK_STONE
Tiling at lane scale: grass over dirt, dirt, stone, wood, copper, iron, gold. Mining at 6x: stone, then CRACK_1..3 laid over it
Beds at 6x (row 0 is the surface the sleeper lies on)
